The *Ganthagocchaka, Kusalattika* is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Patthana, designated as Patthana 3.6. Structurally, it treats the analytical cluster on bodily knots or ties (*ganthagocchaka*) in combination with the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate phenomena (*kusalattika*) within the Patthana's exhaustive matrix of conditional relations.

No specialized discussions, translations, or secondary citations are recorded in the dossier for this specific section.
